ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Provides direct income support of Rs. 6,000 per year, paid in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 each via Direct Benefit Transfer, to landholding farmer families to help with agriculture-related expenses.
eligibility_clauses: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
The farmer family (husband, wife, and minor children) must collectively own cultivable agricultural land, recorded in official state/UT land records, before 1 February 2019.
Institutional landholders are excluded.
Sitting or former Members of Parliament or State Legislatures, mayors, and district panchayat chairpersons are excluded.
Any serving or retired employee of Central or State Government departments, offices, or ministries is excluded, subject to specific exemptions for certain categories.
Higher-income professionals such as doctors, engineers, and income-tax payers are excluded.
Aadhaar-bank account seeding and completed e-KYC are required to receive installments.
benefit_amount: Rs. 6,000 per year in three installments of Rs. 2,000 each, via Direct Benefit Transfer.
category_state_applicability: All Indian states and UTs; central sector scheme.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority
description: Provides cashless health insurance cover of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization at empanelled public and private hospitals across India.
eligibility_clauses: Rural households meeting at least one SECC-2011 deprivation criterion are eligible: living in a kutcha house with only one room, no adult member aged 16-59, no adult male member aged 16-59, a disabled member with no able-bodied adult, no shelter/destitute, manual scavenger family, primitive tribal group, or legally released bonded labour.
Urban households where a member works in one of the 11 identified occupational categories (e.g. construction worker, domestic worker, street vendor, rag-picker, transport worker) are eligible.

All Indian citizens aged 70 years or above are eligible under the Ayushman Vay Vandana expansion, regardless of income or SECC-2011 status, except those already covered under CGHS/ECHS who must choose one scheme.
Families with a member who pays income tax are generally excluded from the standard (non-70+) category.
Households with a regular, non-contractual government employee are generally excluded from the standard (non-70+) category.
There is no waiting period and pre-existing conditions are covered from day one for eligible beneficiaries.
benefit_amount: Cashless cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
category_state_applicability: All Indian states and UTs; SECC-2011 rural/urban deprivation categories, plus universal coverage for citizens aged 70+.

ministry: Ministry of Finance / Department of Posts (Beti Bachao Beti Padhao initiative)
description: A government-backed small savings scheme for a girl child's future education and marriage expenses, offering a high, quarterly-revised interest rate compounded annually, with tax benefits under Section 80C.
eligibility_clauses: The account can only be opened for a resident Indian girl child, any time from birth until she turns 10 years old.
The account must be opened and managed by a parent or legal guardian until the girl turns 18, after which she can operate it herself.
Generally one account is allowed per girl child, and a maximum of two accounts per family (three in the case of twins/triplets).
Minimum deposit is Rs. 250 and maximum deposit is Rs. 1.5 lakh per financial year, for 15 years from account opening.
The account matures 21 years from the date of opening, or on the girl's marriage after she turns 18, whichever is earlier.
benefit_amount: Interest rate of 8.2% p.a. (Q1-Q2 FY 2026-27, compounded annually, subject to quarterly government revision); tax-free (EEE) status; deduction up to Rs. 1.5 lakh under Section 80C.
category_state_applicability: All Indian states and UTs; for families with a girl child under 10.

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Ministry of Rural Development
description: Provides financial assistance and interest subsidy to eligible households to construct or purchase a pucca house, aimed at achieving 'Housing for All'.
eligibility_clauses: Applicant or applicant's family must not already own a pucca house anywhere in India.
Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Lower Income Group (LIG) households are prioritized under PMAY-Urban; specific income slabs apply and should be verified against the current PMAY-U guidelines.
PMAY-Gramin targets houseless households and those living in kutcha/dilapidated houses in rural areas, based on the Socio-Economic Caste Census / Awaas+ survey list.
Preference is given to SC/ST households, minorities, persons with disabilities, and women-headed households, subject to state-specific implementation rules.
benefit_amount: Central assistance/interest subsidy for house construction or purchase; exact amount varies by PMAY-U vertical (BLC/AHP/ISS) or PMAY-G unit cost, and by state.
category_state_applicability: All Indian states and UTs; separate urban and rural (Gramin) verticals with different eligibility lists.
note: Income slab thresholds change periodically - verify current EWS/LIG/MIG limits against the official PMAY portal before using for a firm eligibility decision.

ministry: Ministry of Finance / Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
description: A government-backed voluntary pension scheme mainly for workers in the unorganised sector, providing a guaranteed monthly pension after age 60 based on the subscriber's chosen contribution amount.
eligibility_clauses: Applicant must be an Indian citizen between 18 and 40 years of age at the time of joining.
Applicant must have a savings bank account or post office savings account linked for auto-debit of contributions.
Applicant should not be an income-tax payer, per eligibility rules introduced in October 2022 (should be re-verified against the latest PFRDA circular).
Contribution amount and tenure determine the guaranteed monthly pension slab (Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000) received after age 60.
benefit_amount: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 after age 60, depending on contribution slab chosen.
category_state_applicability: All Indian states and UTs; primarily targeted at unorganised-sector workers without formal pension coverage.

ministry: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
description: Provides collateral-free loans up to Rs. 20 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises, categorized into Shishu, Kishor, Tarun, and Tarun Plus slabs based on loan amount.
eligibility_clauses: Applicant must be a non-corporate, non-farm small/micro entrepreneur (e.g. shopkeeper, trader, artisan, small manufacturer, or service-sector business).
The business activity must be income-generating and not primarily agricultural (agricultural allied activities may qualify separately under specific conditions).
Loans are collateral-free but standard bank creditworthiness and documentation checks still apply.
Shishu covers loans up to Rs. 50,000; Kishor covers Rs. 50,001 to Rs. 5 lakh; Tarun covers Rs. 5,00,001 to Rs. 10 lakh; Tarun Plus covers above Rs. 10 lakh up to Rs. 20 lakh.
benefit_amount: Collateral-free loans up to Rs. 20 lakh across Shishu/Kishor/Tarun/Tarun Plus slabs, from participating banks, NBFCs, and MFIs.
category_state_applicability: All Indian states and UTs; for micro and small non-farm enterprises.

scheme_name: National Scholarship Portal - Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC/EBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
description: Provides financial assistance covering course fees, maintenance allowance, and other charges to students from SC, ST, OBC, and Economically Backward Class categories studying at the post-matriculation (post-Class-10) level.
eligibility_clauses: Applicant must belong to SC, ST, OBC, or Economically Backward Class category, as applicable to the specific scheme variant.
Applicant must be enrolled in a recognized post-matric (post-Class-10) course - including undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, or professional courses.

Family income must be below the annual income ceiling prescribed for the relevant category and scheme cycle - the exact ceiling is revised periodically and must be checked on the National Scholarship Portal for the current academic year.
Applicant must not be receiving any other scholarship for the same course/period (no dual benefit).
benefit_amount: Course fee reimbursement, maintenance allowance, and other allowances; amounts vary by course, category, and state/central scheme variant.
category_state_applicability: SC/ST/OBC/EBC students across India; income ceilings and exact amounts vary by category and are revised periodically.
note: Income ceilings and benefit amounts change by academic year - verify against the current NSP notification before use in a firm eligibility decision.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Provides crop insurance coverage against yield losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases, at a low, uniform farmer premium rate, for notified crops in notified areas.
eligibility_clauses: Applicant must be a farmer (owner-cultivator or tenant/sharecropper with valid land or tenancy records) growing a notified crop in a notified area for that season.
Enrolment is voluntary for all farmers (compulsory enrolment for loanee farmers was made optional following 2020 scheme revisions - verify current status for the relevant state/season).
Farmer premium is capped at 2% of sum insured for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops; the remaining actuarial premium is subsidized by the government.
Application must be made within the enrolment window announced for each crop season (Kharif/Rabi) in the applicant's state.
benefit_amount: Insurance payout for assessed crop yield loss due to natural calamities, pests, or diseases, based on sum insured; farmer premium capped at 1.5-5% depending on crop/season.
category_state_applicability: Farmers in states/UTs that have notified PMFBY for the relevant crop season (implementation varies by state).
